credits.source: "V-19 Torrent Starfighter" by A308 Digital (https://sketchfab.com/A308), CC BY 4.0
credits.changes: Rebuilt as editable KUAT SHIPWRIGHT airframe, markings, cockpit or droid systems, power plant, cooling, weapons and articulation from the credited model and published references.
credits.variant: V-19 Torrent · early Republic short-range interceptor
credits.accelerationBasis: 既存作例の設計目標値。
credits.notes: 初期の短距離迎撃型。左右翼と機尾中央翼に独立ヒンジを設定。中央翼は腹面と背面の間を回転する。

armamentAudit.method: 砲口直後の筒の外径×0.75。寸法は参照モデルの造形値。

measurements.measurement: Cannon_wing_0。マズルスリーブ手前の直管（z=0.009～0.022）、左右対称。

launcherMagazines.note: 左右の震盪ミサイル発射管に3発ずつ、計6発。
